metadata.purpose: Defer subscription to the producer using a scheduled action; preserve source notification ordering and cancellation.

conditions: One scheduled subscription action precedes any source acquisition.
Cancelling before the scheduler fires prevents producer subscription entirely.
Once connected, next/error/complete are not separately scheduled.

scope.parameters: One FIFO virtual scheduler with a safe integer 0..8 delay, including deferred delay=0.
scope.callbacks: The scheduler executes a source-subscription thunk; no user projection callback.
scope.time: Scheduler determines connection time. Source itself determines notification times after connection.
scope.reentrancy: Deferred scheduler action (TestScheduler-like) and non-reentrant subsequent source delivery.
exclusions: queueScheduler synchronous zero-delay execution, arbitrary scheduler implementations/throws.
Actual wall-clock drift, source delivery during the atomic scheduling reaction, reentrant observers.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Schedule source acquisition; subscribe to source only on the selected scheduler action.

ownership.sharing: No sharing; each downstream subscription independently schedules its own source acquisition.
ownership.reset: One new scheduler action per subscription, with its cancellation ownership.

dispatch.actionSemantics: schedule on subscribe; subscribe producer only on timer.fire; cancellation cancels timer or source based on state.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between reactions, on source termination and on downstream cancellation.

controls.description: source is live with subscription-local state
scheduler owns one queued source subscription action
terminal or cancelled; no further source notifications legal
